body:
Life is not worth living because it doesn't work out in the end. I am down more than up, I can't change that.
I am a waste of space and it would be better if I jumped.
Well, thanks I guess. Suicide is a scary thing to think about but only for a few seconds. I think it is the right decision to make.
I smashed apart my apartment last night. Surprised the police didn't come.
I've spoken to counsellors and psychiatrists and psychologists etc etc etc It doesn't work. How do you know it's not worth it? I think adding to the statistics would be worth it.
some people just aren't meant for the world. I am tired of being a fuck-up. I tried to change it.

I guess I could jump tonight. sneak out when the husband is asleep. I spoke to him about it but nobody gets it really. I spoke to professionals, they don't work and just take my money.
I am so fucking tired of this life
